title: Moment of Weakness
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ji was deep in thought, heavy footsteps suddenly echoed outside the Servants' Quarters, accompanied by a familiar, wild laughter—Han Lie had actually come in person.

text.content:
In the dim Servants' Quarters, Chen Ji sat leaning against the wall, his face pale as paper. That moment of foresight had shown him the truth of the interrogation, but at a cost—his Heavenly Fate Value plummeting from seventy-three to sixty-eight.

Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind, carrying a warning: "If your Heavenly Fate Value drops below sixty, you will lose your foresight ability. Below fifty... that is the true beginning of death."

Chen Ji closed his eyes, feeling the soreness and weakness spreading through his limbs. This body was demanding its price—every use of the Tianji Record felt like burning away his lifespan.

Footsteps sounded outside the window, and scattered whispers stopped at the door.

"Did you hear about that废物? The interrogation results point to an elder!"

"Hmph, him? He's probably just trying to bite someone above him."

"Shh, keep your voice down. But I heard he's recently offended the wrong person. Tsk tsk, this is going to be entertaining."

A faint smile tugged at Chen Ji's lips, but there was no笑意 in his eyes. They thought he couldn't hear? He had memorized every voice, every person.

dialogue.content: (Voice weak but calm) Interesting... The rumors are spreading faster than expected.

text.content:
He slowly raised his hand, fingertips trembling slightly. The weakness washed over him like a tide—this was the aftereffect of using the Tianji Record—his body temporarily emptied, as if something had gnawed at it.

But his gaze remained clear, even sharper than usual.

(Inner thoughts) The interrogation results are false. That elder is just a scapegoat. The real mastermind... can't sit still anymore, and has started making moves.

choice.prompt: The situation is dire, rumors are spreading everywhere, and the weakened Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.description: Continue feigning weakness, let the enemy lower their guard, and secretly observe the real mastermind
choices.risk_hint: Lower risk but may miss the chance to counterattack

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, his breathing becoming long and weak. He wanted everyone to believe that the废物 had completely collapsed.

choices.description: Use the remaining Tianji Record ability to create unfavorable situations for them in the shadows
choices.visible_reward: Make enemies suspicious of each other
choices.risk_hint: May expose the existence of the Tianji Record

dialogue.content: (Inner monologue) Not rushed. The show has just begun. Since you all want to play, I'll play along until the end.

text.content: His withered fingers sketched in the air, as if laying an invisible net.

Just then, the door was kicked open.

A young man in Inner Sect robes strode in, followed by two arrogant servants with their noses in the air. His eyes were filled with undisguised malice, and a mocking smile hung on his lips.

"Oh, isn't this our 'Heaven's Favorite' Chen Ji, junior brother? What's wrong, sick?" The young man deliberately stressed the word "sick," his eyes full of schadenfreude.

Chen Ji recognized him—Zhao Heng, the Outer Disciple who lost to him in the Sect Competition three months ago due to Chen Ji's schemes. That victory hadn't been glorious; it could even be called pathetic.

Zhao Heng clearly remembered that day too. He stepped closer, looking down at Chen Ji sitting in the corner: "I heard junior brother got involved in something big? Tsk tsk, offending an elder—how will you收拾 this?"

His tone was full of schadenfreude, as if he could already see Chen Ji being expelled from the sect.

dialogue.content: (Coughing weakly twice) Senior Brother Zhao...cough...what an honor...

text.content:
Zhao Heng burst out laughing, the sound sharp and piercing: "Ah, junior brother's body is truly weak! Don't worry, don't worry, senior brother just came to see you, nothing more. After all, you're now...tsk tsk, a丧家之犬!"

The two servants behind him laughed too, their eyes full of trampling on the weak.

Chen Ji lowered his head, shoulders trembling slightly, looking like he was enduring great humiliation.

choice.prompt: Faced with someone kicking a man while he's down, how will the weakened Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Let them mock freely, secretly memorize every face, and wait to settle accounts later

dialogue.content: (Voice hoarse) Senior Brother Zhao is right...junior brother admits his mistake...

text.content: His voice carried just the right amount of trembling, his eyes lowered, avoiding eye contact with anyone—the perfect废物 posture.

choices.description: Use his weak voice to speak heart-piercing words, making the other party realize they have no standing before him

dialogue.content: (A slight smile) Senior Brother Zhao's match that he lost to me...I remember it clearly. Brother said back then, if I dared to win, he'd make me regret it. Now...I'd like to see how Brother will make me regret it?

text.content: His voice was weak, but that smile sent a chill down Zhao Heng's spine.

Zhao Heng's expression shifted slightly, clearly stung by these words. But he quickly regained composure, coldly laughing: "What a sharp tongue! Unfortunately, who doesn't know now that you offended the wrong person? That elder...hehe, you think you still have any chance of a comeback?"

He lowered his voice, leaning close to Chen Ji's ear: "Be smart. Honestly confess your crimes. You might at least keep your body intact."

With that, he straightened up and swaggered toward the door, deliberately kicking over Chen Ji's medicine bowl by the bed as he left.

The shattering sound echoed through the Servants' Quarters. Chen Ji watched the medicine seep into the soil, a cold glint flashing in his eyes.

That was a Foundation Building Elixir he had someone purchase from down the mountain—extraordinary for recovering Heavenly Fate Value depletion. Something money couldn't easily buy.

(Inner thoughts) Remembered. Zhao Heng, and whoever is pulling your strings. I won't forget a single one.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: "Boy, your enemies are more numerous than you think. That elder...is just a pawn."

dialogue.content: (Inner response) I know. Ling Yuan...he finally can't sit still.

text.content:
Chen Ji struggled to stand from the corner, steadying himself against the wall. His legs were weak, nearly buckling again, but he gritted his teeth and forced himself to stand.

Through the torn window paper, he saw several figures watching from afar—all clearly here to watch the show. Those who had once avoided him now dared to openly kick him while he was down.

Such is human nature.

choice.prompt: More footsteps sounded outside the Servants' Quarters, heavier and more powerful this time. Chen Ji needs to decide—

choices.description: Pretend not to notice, secretly observe the visitor's identity and purpose
choices.visible_cost: May fall into a passive position
choices.risk_hint: The visitor may seize the initiative

text.content: Chen Ji slowly sat back into the corner, putting on a weak and dazed appearance, deliberately slowing his breathing several notches.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's remaining perception to judge the visitor in advance, preparing for countermeasures

dialogue.content: (Eyes closed in concentration) That aura...fire-attribute elemental energy, overbearing and fierce, carrying an extremely confident bearing...someone from Xuanwu Sect?

text.content: Chen Ji opened his eyes, a meaningful smile appearing at the corner of his lips. Han Lie had come even faster than he expected.

The footsteps drew closer, finally stopping at the door of the Servants' Quarters.

A tall figure appeared in the doorframe, nearly blocking the entire entrance. The visitor wore Xuanwu Sect's distinctive Black Iron Battle Armor, a roaring Turtle-Beast embroidered on his chest, his aura pressing down like a mountain.

It was Han Lie, the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect.

Han Lie's gaze swept across the dilapidated Servants' Quarters before landing on Chen Ji, his brow furrowing slightly: "This place?"

His tone carried undisguised contempt, as if coming here was beneath his dignity.

Chen Ji slowly rose from the wall, his face wearing just the right amount of surprise and panic: "Han...Han Gongzi? Why are you here?"

His voice was weak and trembling, his body swaying several times before勉强稳住. This appearance would make anyone see a pitiful废物.

Han Lie stared at him for a long while, then suddenly burst into laughter: "Hahaha! So this is the Chen Ji who defeated me three times? Look at this state! Just a sickly wretch!"

His laughter shook dust from the roof, and his followers behind him joined in the laughter.

Chen Ji kept his head down, saying nothing, but his hands secretly clenched in his sleeves.

(Inner thoughts) Han Lie...you've come at the right time. Let me see what tricks this brute has up his sleeve this time.

Han Lie finished laughing and strode into the Servants' Quarters, practically pressing his face close to Chen Ji's, looking down at him: "I heard you got into trouble? All three major sects are spreading it—that废物 Chen Ji of Tianqing Sect offended the wrong person and is about to be purged."

He deliberately paused, a playful glint flickering in his eyes: "I specially came to see how you've fallen to such a state. After all...an opponent like you, if you die at someone else's hands, wouldn't that be such a waste?"

dialogue.content: (Coughing twice,勉强 forcing out a bitter smile) Han Gongzi...cough...well said. Junior brother truly is...a tiger fallen to flat ground...

text.content:
Han Lie stared at him for a long time, seemingly trying to find some flaw in his expression. But Chen Ji's performance was too perfect—pale face, trembling hands, evasive gaze—every detail told the story of a "broken废物 on the verge of collapse."

Finally, Han Lie lost interest. He stepped back, coldly saying: "Truly uninteresting. I thought you'd give me a few more surprises, but you've turned into a puddle of mud this quickly."

He turned to leave, then paused, looking back with one final line: "By the way, someone asked me to deliver a message—the elder was just the appetizer. The real清算...is yet to come."

With that, he walked away without looking back, leaving the room in silence.

The footsteps gradually faded into the distance, and the Servants' Quarters fell into dead silence once more.

Chen Ji slowly straightened up, the weakness and panic on his face ebbing away like a tide, replaced by an icy composure.

"Appetizer...the清算 is yet to come..." he quietly repeated Han Lie's words, a cold smile curling at his lips, "Ling Yuan ah Ling Yuan, you truly can't stay calm."

He sat back down in the corner and closed his eyes. The weakness still gnawed at his body, but his mind was clearer than ever.

This round, he had lost half a move. But the chess game had only just begun.

Outside the window, the setting sun sank westward, twilight thickening. Chen Ji knew a greater storm was brewing. And he, must rise again before the storm arrives.
